# opnsense_haproxy_acl (Resource)

Manages an OPNsense HAProxy ACL. The `ssl_sni*` expressions are suitable for SNI-based L4 TLS passthrough routing.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expression` (String) HAProxy ACL expression selector, for example `ssl_sni`, `ssl_sni_reg`, `ssl_hello_type`, or `custom_acl`.
- `name` (String) Unique HAProxy ACL name.

### Optional

- `case_sensitive` (Boolean) Whether matching is case-sensitive. Defaults to `false`.
- `custom_acl` (String) Raw custom ACL expression.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `negate` (Boolean) Whether to negate the ACL. Defaults to `false`.
- `ssl_fc_sni` (String) Exact SNI value for the `ssl_fc_sni` expression.
- `ssl_hello_type` (String) TLS hello type used by the `ssl_hello_type` expression.
- `ssl_sni` (String) Exact ClientHello SNI value for the `ssl_sni` expression.
- `ssl_sni_beg` (String) Prefix for `ssl_sni_beg`.
- `ssl_sni_end` (String) Suffix for `ssl_sni_end`.
- `ssl_sni_reg` (String) Regular expression for `ssl_sni_reg`.
- `ssl_sni_sub` (String) Substring for `ssl_sni_sub`.
- `value` (String) Generic expression value used by applicable ACL types.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the HAProxy ACL.
